subject.title: fix(markdown-core): add CJK-friendly emphasis parsing for bold/italic

question: Should OpenClaw accept markdown-it-cjk-friendly as a new core runtime dependency for this parser fix, or require an equivalent no-new-dependency implementation?
rationale: The code path is the right layer for the bug, but dependency graph changes are an explicit security-controlled boundary and the new package has a Socket low-adoption warning plus a private markdown-it internals dependency.

options.title: Approve dependency path
options.body: Secops/admin reviews markdown-it-cjk-friendly and get-east-asian-width for this exact head, authorizes the dependency change, and the PR adds focused proof before merge.

options.title: Require no-new-dependency fix
options.body: The contributor or a replacement branch implements an owned narrow parser amendment or pre-pass with tests, avoiding the supply-chain change at the cost of maintaining Unicode parsing logic.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Keep the linked issue as the canonical bug and pause or close this branch if maintainers do not want either global parser semantic change right now.

recommendation.title: Approve dependency path
recommendation.body: Secops/admin reviews markdown-it-cjk-friendly and get-east-asian-width for this exact head, authorizes the dependency change, and the PR adds focused proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the markdown-core package surface and is also one of the configured dependency-guard security approver candidates in the repository workflow.
